During this Milestone, we were able to successfully launch the entire C-Hub suite in the apple testing environment. The app is currently filled with companies we made up just to get testing done while still providing a cohesive experience. For the next milestone (beta test) we will work towards cleaning up the feedback provided and getting android ready. Additionally, we hit our marketing goals of 3 posts and a professionally made video advertisement.

ms.report:
During the Final Milestone of this proposal, we were met with several obstacles, all of which we overcame. We are happy to announce that C-hub is live and functional. After 2 rounds of testing, albeit limited, we are happy with the progress shown since C-hubs inception in Fund 12. The core foundation is built, tested, and ready to get to work and our focus shifts from building to onboarding. 

A. Output: Platform should be concluded to the point of main-net launch

Evidence: Link to Live Platform
